rules: A change is not effective until approved, propagated, distributed, and verified.
Safety HOLD, ABORT, or STOP authority overrides planned execution; resulting changes enter controlled propagation.
Operational handoffs and Git commits are evidence, not approval signatures.
Pending propagation and validation limitations remain visible until resolved.
